items.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) is practicing in full for Denver’s Week 12 game against the Steelers.
items.text: Bryant survived an injury scare on Sunday and this confirms that he should be in a good place to play on Friday. He took over as Denver’s No. 2 receiver against the Raiders, out-targeting Courtland Sutton 4-2, but wasn’t able to make much fantasy hay of the increased workload. Pittsburgh should be another game that mostly sees Bryant as a FLEX play at best. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Free agent WR Brandon Aiyuk will visit the Commanders on Wednesday.
items.text: Aiyuk’s last two days have gone pretty much exactly what you would have expected after the 49ers finally released him. He’ll likely sign with the Commanders practice squad officially tomorrow. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Broncos designated Tyler Badie (thumb) to return from injured reserve.
items.text: His 21-day window opens with a full practice. Seems like perhaps J.K. Dobbins’ suspension has accelerated the timeline on this decision, so Badie may have a chance to be activated for Friday’s game against the Steelers. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Roschon Johnson (ankle) did not practice on Tuesday.
items.text: We wouldn’t be surprised if he was an IR candidate after he was carted off during Week 11’s win over the Saints. Salvon Ahmed will likely take over third-string duties for the Bears. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Sam LaPorta (ankle) practiced in full on Tuesday.
items.text: LaPorta profiles as a TE1 option in a game with a juicy 55.5 over/under on Thanksgiving. This full session should assure that he skips the questionable line and proceeds directly to a fun game script in the early window. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Christian Benford (groin) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
items.text: It’s his first practice since suffering the groin injury in Week 10. We had a feeling the Bills would do all they could to have the full roster ready for the Chiefs and it appears Benford will indeed have a chance to suit up. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
items.text: Kincaid talked to reporters after practice and said he is “most likely” playing on Thanksgiving. Not a surprise after a pair of limited sessions, it seems like the Bills simply used their Week 11 game against the Dolphins as an exhibition to rest Kincaid ahead of the Chiefs game. He’ll be on the TE1 line if, as expected, he goes. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk cleared waivers on Tuesday, making him a free agent.
items.text: Nobody claimed his 49ers contract. Our next blurb on Aiyuk will probably read something like “Commanders signed WR Brandon Aiyuk,” but until then we’re legally obligated to note that Adam Schefter reported he is expected to draw interest from “a few teams.” - Rivers McCown

items.title: Bears claimed CB Isaac Yiadom off waivers from the Commanders.
items.text: Yiadom has been a decent depth corner for most of the last half-decade, but only played on special teams with the Commanders this year. Perhaps the Bears see more in him, or perhaps they just need a gunner. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Broncos coach Sean Payton said he suspended J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team.
items.text: For those of you who haven’t had the pleasure of rostering Dobbins anywhere, know that he played just one snap on Sunday. Whatever went down almost certainly has something to do with that low snap count, though Payton wouldn’t get into it publicly with reporters. If Dobbins could agitate enough to get released, maybe we’d get somewhere in fantasy circles, but as it stands there’s no reason to hold him in shallow leagues. - Rivers McCown
